svg.title: Concept atlas — Technique language
svg.desc: 372 research families in identical positions in every panel. Color is cosine alignment with the concept minus its average across all families.

g.text: 372 research families · identical positions · alignment with each concept
Shared color scale ±0.07 cosine from each concept’s mean; extremes clipped. Weaker alignment does not imply an opposite.
Scores use family titles, descriptions, and paper abstracts. Technique panels do not establish how a proof works.
